summary: Telltale's Back to the Future adventure game is an episodic licensed continuation of the film trilogy, complicated by delisting and a console-only 30th Anniversary Edition.

entries.title: Back to the Future: The Game
entries.definitive_edition: 30th Anniversary Edition if legally owned; original PC episodes as a fallback owned-copy route

emulation.notes: Use original console hardware/backward compatibility or owned PC install.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Owned 30th Anniversary Edition, with PC episodic route labeled separately

primary.why: The 30th Anniversary Edition is the most complete official version because it updates Biff Tannen's voice work and includes anniversary-era presentation extras, but it is not a dependable current purchase route. The original PC episodes remain useful if already owned, especially for capture, but they lack those console edition changes.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally owned 30th Anniversary Edition on PS4/Xbox One where available, or an already-owned PC episodic release. Record platform, episode, delisted/owned-copy provenance, patch, controller/input, subtitles, save import, and whether the PC or 30th Anniversary voice/content route was used.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original Telltale PC route and easier capture if already owned
secondary.what_to_play: Use when the console anniversary edition is unavailable.
secondary.why: It is historically important but lacks some 30th Anniversary Edition updates.

all_releases.platform: Windows / macOS / PlayStation 3 / Wii / iOS episodic release
all_releases.reason: secondary: original release family, but delisted/owned-copy dependent.

all_releases.platform: PlayStation 4 / Xbox One / Xbox 360 30th Anniversary Edition
all_releases.fidelity: Updated anniversary route with Thomas F. Wilson's Biff voice work.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete official version if legally owned.

all_releases.fidelity: No reliable normal current purchase route.
all_releases.reason: skip: preserve only through owned copies or physical media.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The most complete anniversary edition is console-only and delisted/owned-copy dependent; original PC episodes are easier to capture but not feature-identical.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not point to unofficial downloads. Record delisted status, ownership provenance, and whether Biff's anniversary voice update is present.
